title: GTA 6 pre-orders: real numbers vs fake numbers
yt_title: Most pre-ordered game EVER… but how many? 💰
description: Sony and Microsoft confirmed GTA 6 is the most pre-ordered game in PlayStation Store and Microsoft Store history, without numbers. Sensor Tower's 12M+ is an estimate; 15M / $1.45B has no primary source. 'Rockstar confirmed $1B' is false: no official figure exists.
tiktok_caption: GTA 6 is the most pre-ordered game EVER 💰 But the numbers going around? Mostly guesses. Did you pre-order? 👇

lines.text: GTA 6 is the most pre-ordered game in PlayStation and Xbox store history.
lines.headline: BIGGEST EVER

lines.text: Sony and Microsoft said so. But they gave no numbers.
lines.headline: NO NUMBERS

lines.text: Sensor Tower reportedly estimates over 12 million digital pre-orders.
lines.headline: 12M+?

lines.text: Some sites claim 15 million, and 1.45 billion dollars. No primary source.
Rockstar confirmed a billion in pre-orders? False. They published no figure.
What Take-Two did say: pre-orders are far above expectations.
We find out November 19th, on PS5 and Xbox Series.
lines.headline: NOV 19

lines.text: Did you pre-order? Tell me below, and follow for confirmed GTA 6 news.
lines.headline: DID YOU?
